entries.192546017b5fe7a4: In May 2001 it opened the 'Bond University-BBT MBA (Master of Business Administration) Program'. In July of the same year, through a share exchange for the purpose of business integration, it made Disutarāningu Co., Ltd., which runs an online management education business, a wholly owned subsidiary (it was dissolved in March 2005).

entries.2031aaf3939594c3: A reportable segment that mainly targets working adults, providing next-generation management talent development and IT management support for corporations, reskilling for individuals, language education ranging from business professionals to elementary, junior high and high school students, and university and graduate school degree programs.
entries.246bf3b4fce154d6: The [Material Contracts] section states that the service agreement (Service Agreement) between the company and Bond University for the MBA program partnership runs from April 1, 2001 to October 31, 2003, and is automatically renewed in 2-year periods thereafter. It is currently offered as 'BOND-BBT MBA' in the University business category of the Recurrent Education Business, and in August 2025 it was designated as eligible for the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare's 'Specialized Training Benefit'.
entries.25e89f7a972f7c9e: According to the cover page, the company's current listing is on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. BB Resort Co., Ltd. is a company that became a subsidiary in May 2011 through the acquisition of all of its shares.

entries.3528dd935f8e2a4d: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,668 million (down 0.4% from the prior year). The Platform Service Business rose 2.8% to ¥4,199 million, and the annual securities report states that steady growth in student numbers drove earnings and that both revenue and operating profit reached record highs. The Recurrent Education Business fell 4.1% to ¥3,457 million. The annual securities report states that next-generation management talent development training was in a lull between implementation cycles for its major clients, with revenue roughly flat from the prior year, and that IT Planners Japan Asia Pacific Co., Ltd., which handles IT management, saw lower revenue because a large reskilling project in the prior year had run its course.
entries.36874a74eab3463d: Make IT Purenāzu Japan Asia Pacific a subsidiary and establish ABS Co., Ltd.
entries.370ce1ea47d809ef: This area covers next-generation management talent development programs aimed mainly at executives, executive candidates and manager-level staff, hierarchical leadership training, and generative AI implementation training for companies. Its subsidiary Aoba-BBT Global provides online English for business people and online English conversation for children, and ITplanners Japan Asia Pacific provides corporate training materials and training services for IT management areas such as DX and agile. The study group "Kokokai", led by Kenichi Ohmae and held in Tokyo, Nagoya, Osaka and Fukuoka for about 400 company executives, is also listed as a program in this area.
entries.401696a0de748696: Provision of education services, including corporate training, degree programs at universities and graduate schools, English education, and IT management training (Recurrent Education Business; ¥3,457 million)
entries.43ab87e5581230ec: An IB PYP-accredited school with 6 campuses for ages 1 to 6, offering education based on English-Japanese bilingual education with an emphasis also on intellectual and physical education such as ballet, piano, karate and abacus. The securities report states that the company worked to improve the quality of education while stabilizing its income and expenditure, and that the profit margin improved substantially.
entries.44be3f66a3b4b32e: A school accredited by Cambridge Assessment International Education, covering early childhood through high school, basically English-based, and also offering Japanese, Chinese, and IT/STEM/robotics education.

entries.4ba7a678037a8d78: The company handles content production for the Recurrent Education Business, development of the online learning system, and operation of universities and graduate schools. Its subsidiary Aoba International Educational Systems Co., Ltd. runs international schools, IT Planners Japan Asia Pacific Co., Ltd. handles IT training, and Aoba-BBT Global Co., Ltd. handles English education. Consolidated employees number 629 (as of March 31, 2026; the average annual number of temporary employees is 237).
entries.4c5fae1bf4babfa5: Open an MBA program with Bond University and make Disutarāningu a wholly owned subsidiary through a share exchange.
entries.508fdf2b7065cf31: A school accredited by Cambridge Assessment International Education, covering early childhood through high school, basically English-based, and also offering Japanese, Chinese, and IT/STEM/robotics education. The securities report states that the school has maintained a stable number of students since 2021 and that profitability is becoming stable throughout the year.
entries.540c4d53e3b8ce0a: In October 2013 the company acquired shares of Aoba International Educational Systems Co., Ltd., which operates 'Aoba Japan International School', and made it a subsidiary. In November 2014 it made Gendai Yōji Kiso Kyōiku Kaihatsu Co., Ltd., which operates 'JCQ Bilingual Kindergarten', a subsidiary, and in October 2015 it made Summerhill International Co., Ltd., which operates 'Summerhill International School', a subsidiary, each as a sub-subsidiary of the company, and in March 2021 it absorbed both companies through merger.
entries.566826cf9f321c16: The flagship school, operated on 3 campuses for early childhood through high school. It is accredited for the IB PYP, MYP and DP, and by CIS and NEASC, accrediting bodies for international schools. Graduates are awarded a graduation qualification equivalent to that of graduates of high schools in Europe, the United States and Japan, and eligibility to apply to major universities around the world. The securities report states that in September 2025 the school began a new school year with a record 797 students, and that fixed income such as tuition increased substantially. It is also accredited by the International Baccalaureate Organization and offers a pilot version of the IB-DP program, the first fully online program of its kind in Asia.
entries.58c6bf7f94ad8514: In April 2002 it opened the 'Ōmae Keiei Juku' and began providing services using the online learning system 'AirCampus'. In August 2002 the company merged 2 companies, Breakthrough Co., Ltd. (management education) and Erutī Enpawā Co., Ltd. (online education content production), for the purpose of business integration, and also transferred the operations of 'Kōkenkai'.
entries.5b74a7373b51fae1: Partnership with Hokuriku Gakuin Educational Corporation and absorption mergers of 3 subsidiaries
entries.5ff5c3c2f6273236: Business Breakthrough University Graduate School is currently a professional graduate school approved by the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology, and awards the Master of Business Administration (Professional) degree online. The MD&A states that new enrollment at the graduate school in fiscal 2025 rose sharply, up 177% year on year (122 people).
entries.616622dde68065b1: In April 1998, the company was established in Chiyoda Ward, Tokyo, to engage in the online management education business (capital of ¥10 million). In the same month it obtained authorization from the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications (now the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications) as a commissioned broadcasting business operator, and in October 1998 it began 24-hour broadcasting of the 'Business Breakthrough Channel' on channel 757 of SKY PerfecTV! (now Sukapā!).
entries.62e356abe96fe4c4: In April 2005 it opened 'Business Breakthrough Graduate University (now Business Breakthrough University Graduate School)', a graduate school established by a stock company, and in December it listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Mothers Market. In March of the same year it dissolved Disutarāningu Co., Ltd. (a consolidated subsidiary), in which it held a 100% stake.
entries.6aa418095fbd65ac: In January 2025 the company concluded a partnership agreement with Hokuriku Gakuin Educational Corporation for the purpose of cooperation in education. In March 2025 Aoba International Educational Systems Co., Ltd. absorbed Musashi International Education Co., Ltd. through merger; in May the company absorbed ABS Co., Ltd.; and in August the company absorbed MentorMe Co., Ltd. (a company it had made a subsidiary by acquiring all of its shares in June 2024), in each case through merger. The effective dates of the company's mergers are May 1, 2025 for ABS Co., Ltd. and August 1, 2025 for MentorMe Co., Ltd.

On an operating profit basis, segment profit was ¥384 million for the Platform Service Business (up 7.8%) and ¥69 million for the Recurrent Education Business (down 20.7%). The annual securities report states that operating profit exceeded the prior year because the Platform Service Business performed well and posted higher profit.

entries.8cdfc2c82f6ca950: It operates four international schools in Tokyo, with 11 campuses in total, accredited by the International Baccalaureate (IB) or Cambridge Assessment International Education (CAIE). For working adults, it offers online degree programs at Business Breakthrough University and its graduate school, BOND-BBT MBA in partnership with Bond University in Australia, and corporate training, and it also develops in-house the online learning system used to produce and distribute lectures.
entries.8efbb29321f50d21: [[term:annual-securities-report|Annual securities report]] states that the group consists of the company and four consolidated subsidiaries (as of the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026), and that it operates in two reportable segments: the Platform Service Business (international school business-related) and the Recurrent Education Business (human resource development business-related and University business-related). The company sets “Developing leaders who succeed globally” as its basic corporate mission and has adopted the vision “Lifetime Empowerment,” which supports everyone in continuing to learn autonomously throughout their lives. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,668 million: ¥4,199 million from the Platform Service Business and ¥3,457 million from the Recurrent Education Business. In the Recurrent Education Business, the company develops and operates in-house, in an integrated manner, everything from creating lectures and teaching materials, to running training and courses, supporting learners, and operating the online learning system “AirCampus.”

entries.9d6d49fdbbca72d0: The filing states that the company entered this business in 2013 and that it is now the core business driving the company group's revenue. Revenue of the Platform Services Business for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,199 million (up 2.8% year on year), making it the larger of the 2 reportable segments. Aoba International Educational Systems Co., Ltd. is a consolidated subsidiary whose share of consolidated revenue exceeds 10%.
entries.a2a4625d035d323b: This reporting segment mainly targets working adults and provides next-generation management talent development for corporate clients, IT management support, reskilling for individuals, language education from programs for business professionals to programs for children and students from kindergarten through high school, and degree programs at universities and graduate schools. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥3,457 million (down 4.1% year on year), and segment profit was ¥69 million (down 20.7%). The filing says that it integrates the production of lectures and teaching materials, the operation of training and courses, learner support, and the online learning system that delivers lectures, and that it has planned, produced and held more than 19,000 hours of content since its founding. The filing says that revenue for next-generation management talent training was roughly level with the previous period because it fell in a lull between major clients' implementation cycles, and that IT Planners Japan Asia Pacific Co., Ltd., which handles IT management, saw revenue and profit decline following the completion of a large reskilling project in the previous period.

entries.eb1b5987727d204f: Business Breakthrough University is a university approved by the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology, with a Faculty of Management whose students study 100% online. The filing's [Risks Related to Business, etc.] section states that, under the Structural Reform Special Zone plan 'Career Education Promotion Special Zone' certified on October 24, 2003 by the Prime Minister for Chiyoda Ward, Tokyo, it establishes and operates the university as a stock company.
entries.ec47eb1a045d6fcd: The filing notes that from October 2012 the company became a program supplier to Sukapā Broadcasting Co., Ltd., and that from December 2018 its distribution method changed to delivery via 'Amazon Fire TV'. The current [Business Description] states that the company's basic corporate mission is 'Developing leaders who are active around the world'.
entries.f0309de9860c0f2d: A reportable segment that operates international schools mainly for children and students from early childhood to high school age, developing people who will play leading roles in the international community. It is the larger of the 2 reportable segments in revenue from external customers. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,199 million (up 2.8% from the previous fiscal year), and segment profit was ¥384 million (up 7.8%). The securities report states that steady growth in the number of students drove earnings, and that both revenue and operating profit reached record highs. It states that the subsidiary Aoba International Educational Systems Co., Ltd. operates 4 international schools in Tokyo accredited by the International Baccalaureate (IB) or Cambridge Assessment International Education (CAIE), with a total of 11 campuses and more than 1,500 students, making it one of the largest international school groups in Japan.

entries.f68928c13e1868c5: In December 2016 it changed its listing to the First Section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange, and in April 2022, following the Tokyo Stock Exchange's review of its market segments, it moved from the First Section to the Prime Market. In October 2023 it moved from the Prime Market to the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. In the same month, it dissolved BB Resort Co., Ltd. and the Hideaway Atagawa Resort Project Investment Business Partnership.
entries.f6a9fb8de1f44d72: An area that, as a formal educational institution accredited by the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology, provides online degree programs through "Business Breakthrough University (Faculty of Management)" and "Business Breakthrough University Graduate School (MBA)", international degree programs such as the "BOND-BBT MBA" in partnership with Bond University of Australia, and short-term intensive certificate programs (intensive courses). The securities report states that the graduate school's number of new students in fiscal 2025 grew substantially to 177% of the previous year (122 students), while the number of new students in the main course of the BBT University Faculty of Management in fiscal 2026 fell to 24 (69% of the previous year).
entries.f7c34b19cc298ba4: In July 2019, through a newly formed company split, it established ABS Co., Ltd. to succeed to the Attackers Business School division and other operations, and in the same month it acquired all shares of IT Purenāzu Japan Asia Pacific Co., Ltd. and made it a subsidiary.
